description: This PHP file defines the CallsViewEdit class, a specialized view class for editing Call records within the SuiteCRM application. It extends the core ViewEdit class and includes methods to handle pre-display setup and rendering, integrating with system components such as JSON configuration and reminders.

classes.name: CallsViewEdit
classes.description: A view class for editing Call records, managing display logic and configuration integration.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the Call record for display by setting status based on request parameters.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles rendering of the edit view, configuring dynamic JavaScript and reminders data for the interface.
